blocks.task_summary: Find angle JDL in triangle JDL given bearing 034 degrees from J to D, JL = 500 km east, and angle JLD = 25 degrees.
method_path: Convert bearing 034 degrees to interior angle DJL = 90 - 34 = 56 degrees
Apply triangle angle sum: JDL = 180 - 56 - 25 = 99 degrees

evidence.basis: Let N be North. NJD = 34 degrees OR DJL = 56 degrees (must be labelled or indicated in diagram): (A1). JDL = 99 degrees A1. Note: Accept 11pi/20, 1.73 (radians).

blocks.task_summary: Find the distance DL between Lucknow and Delhi using the sine rule in triangle JDL.
method_path: Set up sine rule: DL / sin(56 degrees) = 500 / sin(99 degrees)
Solve for DL: DL = 500 * sin(56 degrees) / sin(99 degrees) = 419.685...
accepted_alternatives: Use radian equivalents: DL / sin(0.977384...) = 500 / sin(1.72787...)

evidence.basis: attempt to apply the sine rule (M1). DL/500 = sin56/sin99 OR DL/500 = sin0.977384.../sin1.72787... (A1). DL = 419.685... then DL = 420 (km) A1. Note: Award M1A1A0 for 261 (km) from use of degrees with GDC set in radians.
